definitions.explanation: An eyelid whose double fold is partly hidden by the skin above it, so the crease is faint or concealed near the inner edge — falling between a clear {二重|ふたえ} (double eyelid) and a {一重|ひとえ} (single eyelid).

examples.japanese: ⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{奥二重|おくぶたえ}だ。
{奥二重|おくぶたえ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦メイク→メイク：11163_meiku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{印象|いんしょう}→印象：01846_inshou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わりやすい→変わりやすい：21113_kawariyasui⟧。
examples.english: Inner double eyelids change impression easily with makeup.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{奥二重|おくぶたえ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{目|め}を{閉|と}じる→目を閉じる：19363_mewotojiru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{一重|ひとえ}→一重：06463_hitoe⟧⟦のように→のように：30291_noyouni⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: She has inner double eyelids, and when she closes her eyes they look single.

notes:
An eyelid whose fold is present but partly tucked under the brow-side skin, so the crease barely shows. It sits between a clear ⟦{二重|ふたえ}→二重：06464_futae⟧ (double eyelid) and a ⟦{一重|ひとえ}→一重：06463_hitoe⟧ (single eyelid), and is a very common feature and a frequent topic in beauty and makeup contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {奥二重|おくぶたえ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧: eyes with a hidden double fold
- {奥二重|おくぶたえ}⟦メイク→メイク：11163_meiku⟧: makeup for inner double eyelids

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{二重|ふたえ}→二重：06464_futae⟧: double eyelid — visible crease
- ⟦{一重|ひとえ}→一重：06463_hitoe⟧: single eyelid — no crease
